global: A steaming bowl of shoyu ramen boasts a rich, amber broth. Topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and finely sliced green onions, it sits in a white ceramic bowl on a warm wooden table, bathed in soft, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and natural knots with smooth, slightly reflective finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface and subtly rounded rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and chashu pork, golden-brown, glossy, and steaming hot.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows caramelized brown exterior, tender white interior, and visible fat marbling with glossy glaze.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, with fibrous texture and irregular, slightly curled, segmented shapes.
